svg.title: Measure the fleet: count what lands, what it cost and what came back
svg.desc: Every night, collectors read three sources into points: the plan's record of merges and landings, git, and moon's run reports. A board grows three series day by day. They are what landed, what it cost in attention as decisions answered, and what it cost in money as tokens by role. Where the stack changed, a mark on the time axis names the new fleet context. Each series has its definition beside its numbers. Crew and sounding keep the records the collectors read.
svg.text: count what lands, what it cost and what came back
the stack changed: a new fleet context

text.tspan: keep the records the collectors read;
